create.name: Victoria Jean Randall
create.bio:
Victoria Jean Randall is an Akashic Records reader and Reiki teacher who works from a small studio in Exeter, on the New Hampshire Seacoast. She has followed an intuitive path for more than twenty years. Her Akashic Records training came through Akashic Records Consultants International, and she holds master-level certification in several Reiki lineages, among them Usui, Karuna and Holy Fire, having studied with the senior Reiki teacher William Lee Rand in Glastonbury, England.

Most of her work is one-to-one: readings in which a client brings questions and she opens their soul's record through a prayer, along with Reiki and spiritual development sessions for people wanting to grow their own intuitive gifts. These take place at her studio, over Zoom or by phone. She also teaches every level of Holy Fire Reiki, runs small community circles and seasonal gatherings, and leads women's retreats in the woods. At Kripalu she is part of the Healing Arts team, giving Akashic readings to guests, and she joins the occasional weekend programme there. Outside her practice she writes children's books about caring for the planet and makes jewellery by hand.

courses.title: Your Wisdom Within: A Journey of Intuition and Self-Trust
courses.description: A weekend at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, on listening to inner guidance and trusting intuition, led by Hilary Crowley. Victoria joins as a guest presenter with a session on the Akashic Records and how the soul carries love across lifetimes.

courses.title: Akashic Records Consultation
courses.description: A private reading of sixty or ninety minutes in which Victoria opens your Akashic Records with a prayer and passes on what comes through in answer to your questions. Available at her Exeter studio, on Zoom or by phone; group, couple and family readings can be arranged.

courses.title: Holy Fire Reiki Training (Levels I, II, III and Master)
courses.description: Hands-on Reiki classes covering every level, from first attunement to master. Students learn the history and principles of Reiki and practise giving it to themselves and to others.
